latestVersion.changelog:
Revenium Skill v0.5.7

- Updated setup instructions to account for sandbox changes: Revenium config is now mounted read-only from the host; users must set credentials on the host, not in the agent session.
- Removed requirement to re-run post-install.sh or restart the gateway when updating credentials; sandbox picks up host changes live.
- Clarified config flow and credential persistence details in SKILL.md.
- No changes to budget enforcement logic.
